thesis: RM61.6bn of orders supports demand but not cash returns at 28.47x earnings. Both arguments depend on an unprovided project-conversion bridge.
strongest_counterexample: The large recent award and constructive longer trend could anticipate profitable backlog conversion before reported cash flow improves.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of negative operating cash flow.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive FCF and positive year-on-year EPS growth.
evidence_gaps: Contract margin, collection schedules and capex-versus-working-capital cash bridge.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: A record backlog and recent award establish demand visibility
A large orderbook strengthens demand visibility but does not fill the cash-conversion gap
